regime.label: Real-yield-driven risk-off: oil spike from the failed Hormuz talks pushed the 10Y near its highest since 2007, dragging equities, gold and silver down together
regime.oneLiner: Monday's selloff has a coherent, sourced cause (oil-spike-to-hawkish-Fed-to-higher-real-yields), not an unexplained cross-asset anomaly -- but that also means Wednesday's Core PCE and Friday's payrolls are now binary catalysts for the whole book, not just bonds.

topNews.headline: Trump rejects Iran's conditional offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; oil spikes, reversing the weekend's talk-optimism dip
topNews.actionable: This failed-talks headline is the trigger for Monday's entire risk-off complex -- don't read the metals weakness as a safe-haven failure, it's a rates story downstream of this rejection.

topNews.headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits ~5.22-5.24%, highest since 2007; Fed October hike odds top 70-75%
topNews.actionable: Real yields are the connective tissue behind Monday's simultaneous equity/gold/silver/crypto selloff -- Wednesday's core-PCE and Friday's payrolls become binary catalysts for the whole book, not just the bond sleeve.
